parsed.evidence_sentence: Within six (6) months prior to ordering the CGM, the treating practitioner has an in-person visit with the beneficiary to evaluate their diabetes control and determined that criteria (1-3) above are met; and,
parsed.wording_differences:
Original: 'Within six (6) months prior to ordering the CGM, the treating practitioner has an in-person visit with the beneficiary to evaluate their diabetes control and determined that criteria (1-4) above are met; and,'
Revised: 'Within six (6) months prior to ordering the CGM, the treating practitioner has an in-person visit with the beneficiary to evaluate their diabetes control and determined that criteria (1-3) above are met; and,'

Difference: The cross-reference to criteria changed from (1-4) to (1-3).
parsed.explanation: The only change is the cross-reference: the original required that the practitioner determine criteria (1-4) were met, while the revised policy requires only criteria (1-3). This means the rule as written is now too strict, as it would deny claims where only (1-3) are met, but the revised policy would allow them. The requirement survives, but the scope of what must be determined at the in-person visit is narrowed.
